# DataReel 7

> DataReel 7 is an object database (OODB) and cross platform communications toolkit for C++17 (LGPL): embedded object databases (block files, disk B-tree indexes, persistent objects) and TLS-only communications (TLS client/server, HTTPS, SMTP, POP3, FTPS) on Linux and Windows.

All classes are in namespace datareel. Link with CMake target DataReel::datareel. Network calls return 0 on success; database calls return gxDatabaseError (gxDBASE_NO_ERROR is 0). Records and keys must be fixed-size (no std::string or pointers). Certificates are verified by default; there is no plain text HTTP, SMTP, POP3 or FTP.

AI-assisted use only: before any AI assistance, review your agency's or company's AI usage policies and get formal written approval from your management team; use only approved enterprise AI models; a person reviews and approves every step (see "Before you use AI assistance" in AGENTS.md). Naming an AI tool is a reference only, not an endorsement.

## Guides

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): AI-assisted use rules, setup, new builds, upgrades, forks, troubleshooting and support, and the rules for writing code with DataReel and changing the library
- [TLS communications](docs/ai/tls-comms.md): TLS clients and servers, HTTPS, SMTP, POP3, FTPS and gxStream, with complete programs
- [Object database](docs/ai/object-database.md): gxDatabase block files, gxBtree indexes, POD and InfoHog persistent objects, vector indexes and sets
- [Building and linking](docs/ai/building.md): CMake options, file format settings, find_package(DataReel), running the tests
- [Porting from 6.x](docs/ai/porting-from-6x.md): Replacements for the removed classes and the move to TLS-only networking
- [Text, CSV, single-instance and file utilities](docs/ai/utilities.md): strip_ansi/AnsiStripper, gxCSVReader/gxCSVWriter, gxProcessLock, hexdump, ffind, txfilter (7.4)
- [Troubleshooting and support](docs/ai/troubleshooting-and-support.md): Read-only checks, problems by area, when to stop and escalate, the support summary

## Reference

- [Readme](README.txt): What the library is for, building, file formats
- [Release notes, all 7.x](RELEASE_NOTES.txt): every 7.x release in one file, newest first
- [Release notes 7.4](RELEASE_NOTES_7.4.txt): Vector extensions: vector index file, exact and HNSW nearest-neighbor search
- [Release notes 7.3.3](RELEASE_NOTES_7.3.3.txt): Database replication fixes (seal per folder, promote-check under the apply lock)
- [Release notes 7.3.2](RELEASE_NOTES_7.3.2.txt): Database replication fixes (channel resync, staged copies, promote)
- [Release notes 7.3.1](RELEASE_NOTES_7.3.1.txt): Security scan fixes for damaged files and journals
- [Release notes 7.3](RELEASE_NOTES_7.3.txt): Memory-mapped reads, faster key-order scans and random reads
- [Release notes 7.2](RELEASE_NOTES_7.2.txt): Journal (crash and power loss safe transactions), page cache, faster I/O and B-tree
- [Release notes 7.1](RELEASE_NOTES_7.1.txt): gxRDBMS removed, reserved error codes
- [Release notes 7.0](RELEASE_NOTES_7.0.txt): Removed classes, rewritten classes, fixes, porting notes
- [Class reference](docs/classes/classes.htm): HTML pages for every class
- [Examples](docs/examples/examples.htm): The example programs and how to run them
